item.title: Administrative Coordinator, Parking Services
item.description: The Parking Services Administrative Coordinator provides customer service and administrative support for Lehigh University's parking operations. The position administers parking permits and accounts, processes payments and appeals, maintains parking and access systems, and supports accurate parking capacity and billing records.
item.ns1:description:
Lehigh University's campus runs on more than academics and the Parking Services team keeps it moving. If you're someone who finds satisfaction in well-run systems, genuinely enjoys helping people, and takes pride in accurate records and smooth processes, this Administrative Coordinator role is a strong fit.

Position Number: S73220

This position is a Grade: 7 - 37.5 with an approximate salary range of $37,190-$44,640 and is subject to change based on experience, skills and qualifications.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Administer parking permits and accounts for students, faculty, and staff — from issuance through renewal and termination
  • Process payments accurately and in a timely manner, maintaining complete and up-to-date billing records
  • Review and process parking appeals, applying university policy consistently and fairly across all cases
  • Maintain parking and access control systems, coordinating updates and escalating technical issues as needed
  • Monitor and maintain accurate parking capacity data to support operational planning and reporting
  • Respond to in-person, phone, and email enquiries from the campus community with professionalism and care
  • Support the reconciliation of parking accounts and assist with end-of-period financial reporting
  • Liaise with campus departments, vendors, and external stakeholders on parking-related matters
  • Assist with the onboarding of new permit holders, including explaining parking policies and procedures clearly
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of administrative processes within the Parking Services office

What You'll Bring

  • High School Diploma or GED
  • Associates Degree preferred
  • Three to five years of related work experience
  • Experience in an administrative, customer service, or office coordination role
  • Confidence handling payment processing and maintaining accurate financial or account records
  • Strong attention to detail and comfort working with database or permit management systems
  • Clear, professional communication skills — in person, over the phone, and in writing
  • The ability to apply established policies consistently, including in situations involving appeals or disputes
  • Familiarity with a university or similarly complex multi-stakeholder environment is an advantage, Lehigh's campus community is diverse and busy year-round

Why Lehigh

Lehigh University brings together a close-knit campus community in Bethlehem, Pennsylvania, with the resources and reputation of a nationally recognized research university. As a staff member in Parking Services, you'll be part of the infrastructure that supports thousands of people every day. Lehigh offers a competitive benefits package that includes generous paid leave, tuition benefits for employees and eligible dependents, strong retirement contributions, and access to campus facilities and programs. The Parking Services team is a collaborative group where your contributions are visible and valued — and where consistent, quality work makes a genuine difference to the campus experience. Lehigh University is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate. We are committed to a culturally and intellectually diverse community and we seek qualified candidates to contribute to the university’s mission. 

Persons with disabilities who anticipate needing an accommodation for any part of the interview or hiring process may contact Lehigh's Accommodations Specialist.

Special Considerations

  • The duties of this position may allow the employee to work partially remote as deemed appropriate by their supervisor.

Successful completion of standard background checks including but not limited to: social security verification, education verification, national criminal background checks, motor vehicle checks, PATCH, FBI fingerprinting, Child Abuse Clearance and credit history based upon the requirements of the position.

Only complete applications will be considered therefore please complete the application in its entirety.  Once the posting is removed from the website applications may no longer be allowed to be completed.
